mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. Imagine a moment when everything you thought was solid suddenly slips away—when old certainties vanish, and you’re left standing at the edge of the unknown. It’s in these tender, challenging spaces that we often find a hidden invitation—not to run or hide, but to transform. In Elizabeth Lesser's beautiful book, Broken Open: How Difficult Times Can Help Us Grow, we’re invited to look at adversity in a completely new light. What if pain, loss, and those unexpected curveballs aren’t just hurdles, but powerful doorways to self-discovery and renewal? Together, we’ll explore how vulnerability and courage can become our greatest allies—how the very moments that threaten to break us can, in truth, awaken us to deeper meaning, compassion, and connection. You’ll hear honest stories, timeless wisdom, and gentle guidance that remind us: being “broken open” isn’t some rare experience—it’s something we all share. And while it’s rarely easy, it can reveal surprising strengths, greater empathy, and a renewed sense of purpose. So, as we step into this journey, let’s keep our hearts open to the idea that every ending might just be the start of something new. And right there, inside every wound, there’s a quiet promise: transformation is possible.
